outcome: COMPLETED — Visitors can trace the three input sets, the recorded arrangements and their seven cuts on the original sheet. Every occupied tile can be entered. Local Back retraces this sequence before returning to the host.

formation: Forest walk on 11 November 2023: seven selected shadows.
The seven images on the overhead projector: three arrangements, seven cuts from each.
All first 28 images: three arrangements, seven cuts from each.
source.mapping: Source rows 1–7 retain their 49 works; rows 2–7 each retain their admitted source cluster. Parentage is shared per arrangement. The feed gives no registration of crop coordinates within a projected cluster.

host_dependency.operation: The site declines generic cell navigation and point ink. Its explicit contacts use its existing sheet tile geometry, including rotation and off-centre activation.

witness.native: Renderer owner regression passed on membership, source positions, gate behavior, actual work/camera relations, local returns, four-way media queues, failure and context ownership. A source cluster can be contacted separately from a shadow. An empty gallery selection is inert.

source_media.HTTP_CORS_and_Pillow: All 110 occupied-slot variants (55 each at the declared 64 and 512 tiers) acquired and decoded; 602544 encoded bytes.
source_media.consumer: Software GLES linked and drew the genuine source tiles at 390×844 and 1280×800. All 55 low and 55 high slots uploaded. A deliberately failed high slot retained its low representation.

witness.visitor: Actual Chromium desktop and touch layouts exercised each of the three source stages, source cluster films, selected stills, and movement only where a source declares it. Source positive/negative for Cluster 1 decoded at 329×512 each. At work 02001, movement returned to the still, then the row, input set and whole. Work 03021 offered no movement; forest shadow 01007 offered no cluster. Ordinary pointer/touch activated both the 02001 cut and Cluster 1 off-centre; a click in an empty tile left the gallery and field unchanged. Mobile Canvas2D and software WebGL2 both rendered the source silhouettes. The Canvas2D run rotated the sheet, restored the orthogonal view and opened 01001 with zero field or page errors.
witness.readability: Native stage, cluster and cut buttons are reachable with Tab and Enter. Ordinary and inverse colors retained visible paper/ink separation in actual desktop and phone rasters. The final footer was tested in English and German on 320×568 and 390×844: the breadcrumb and orthogonal button fit within the declared field and each word had exactly one contiguous text fragment.
witness.limits: The browser and GPU witnesses use software rendering. They make no assertion about physical-device frame rate or public deployment of the review branch.
